title: Payment Protection Plan Line-Up and Covered Events
content:
Payment Protection is attached to a Larkspur personal loan and is offered as six plans. Each plan fixes which losses are protected events, whether a second person is covered, and how benefits work when two people are covered.

**Payment Protection is optional and never a condition of getting or keeping a loan.** This holds for every one of the six plans.

## Protected events and covered persons

| Plan | Death of a covered person | Disability of a covered person | Involuntary unemployment of a covered person | Second covered person (co-borrower or spouse) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment Protection Life | Protected | Not protected | Not protected | No |
| Payment Protection Life and Disability | Protected | Protected | Not protected | No |
| Payment Protection Complete | Protected | Protected | Protected | No |
| Joint Payment Protection Life | Protected | Not protected | Not protected | Yes |
| Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability | Protected | Protected | Not protected | Yes |
| Joint Payment Protection Complete | Protected | Protected | Protected | Yes |

## How benefits work on joint plans

| Plan | Joint benefit rule |
|---|---|
| Payment Protection Life | not covered |
| Payment Protection Life and Disability | not covered |
| Payment Protection Complete | not covered |
| Joint Payment Protection Life | the death of either covered person pays the death benefit; then coverage ends |
| Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability | one disability benefit at a time; the death of either covered person pays the death benefit |
| Joint Payment Protection Complete | one disability or unemployment benefit at a time; the death of either covered person pays the death benefit |

## Work hours for disability and unemployment coverage

The hours per week of work required at the loss date for disability or unemployment coverage are set per plan; a life-only plan carries no such requirement ("not covered").

| Plan | Minimum hours of work per week |
|---|---|
| Payment Protection Life | not covered |
| Payment Protection Life and Disability | 30 |
| Payment Protection Complete | 30 |
| Joint Payment Protection Life | not covered |
| Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability | 30 |
| Joint Payment Protection Complete | 30 |

## Plans per loan and enrollment channels

| Plan | Payment Protection plans allowed on one loan | Channels through which the borrower can enroll |
|---|---|---|
| Payment Protection Life | 1 | phone, online |
| Payment Protection Life and Disability | 1 | phone, online |
| Payment Protection Complete | 1 | phone, online |
| Joint Payment Protection Life | 1 | phone, online |
| Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability | 1 | phone, online |
| Joint Payment Protection Complete | 1 | phone, online |

## Reading the line-up

- **Is death protected on every plan?** Yes: the death column reads "Protected" for all six plans.
- **Which plans protect involuntary unemployment?** Payment Protection Complete and Joint Payment Protection Complete, and no other plan.
- **On a joint plan, can two monthly benefits run at the same time?** No. Joint Payment Protection Life and Disability pays one disability benefit at a time, and Joint Payment Protection Complete pays one disability or unemployment benefit at a time.
- **Does a single-person plan cover a spouse?** No. Only the three joint plans cover a second person, who is a co-borrower or spouse.
